title: Decoder floors, closures: punctured E8 units (Model C) for 48 ≤ p ≤ 56, all m (no κ claim)
body:
Closures-only follow-up of #2639 (open; this PR is based on it and uses its tools and Theorem M8 as stated there). **No κ claim.**

#2639 §4 lists `m ≤ 7` at `48 ≤ p ≤ 56` as open. This note closes it, in the same setting (punctured E8 units, Model C: dense `B`, column-space factors), so **every `p` with `48 ≤ p ≤ 56` is closed for every `m`** (`m ≥ 8`: #2639 Theorem M8 with its Case-B census; `m ≤ 7`: this PR).

* **Reduction (PROVEN from #2639's E7q, Lemma G/H/R, monotonicity in `P`).** `48 ≤ p ≤ 53`: a root with `q ≤ Q(p)` is closed by E7q, otherwise all `q_γ ≥ 6`; `54 ≤ p ≤ 56`: `q ≤ 16` is closed by Lemma R (`m = 7`: cost ≥ 35 ≥ need(p)), otherwise all `q_γ ≥ 17`. `m ≤ 7` then needs a Lemma-G failure, i.e. SAT of one CNF per rank-7 flat type: (I-a) `P = 53`, all `q_γ ≥ 6` (covers 48–53); (I-b) `P = 56`, all `q_γ ≥ 17` (covers 54–56).
* **Result (RECORDED from the author's working card; sample re-checked).** All 8 flat types are UNSAT-VERIFIED for both families: every leaf of the orbit trees is kissat + drat-trim VERIFIED against its own CNF, or a counting leaf (`|T| > P`); no SAT, no TIMEOUT. Per-leaf tables with the md5 of every leaf CNF, state files and run summaries are shipped.
* **`verify.sh`** (≈ 15 min, one core, `nice 10`): manifest/pins; tallies and arithmetic; rebuilds the option sets for 4 of the 8 types from scratch (E8 lines, 440,880 rank-7 flats); encoding checks (leaf CNF vs. direct numpy test, 880 sets, kissat); tree coverage (`c3`: each orbit tree re-walked with an oracle leaf, every recorded leaf visited, none missing; CHECKED); then regenerates 60 leaf CNFs per (type, family), compares md5 with the recorded runs and sha256 with pins, and re-solves 15 per (type, family) with kissat + drat-trim. `FULL=1` does every leaf and the coverage of all 8 types (hours).
* **Proofs shipped:** 12 small leaf DRAT proofs (xz) with sha256 of proof and CNF, drat-trimmed by `verify.sh` against regenerated CNFs; the other leaf proofs are RECORDED (md5-pinned CNFs, regenerable).
* **Imported from #2639 (open), labels as there:** E7q PROVEN from CHECKED data; Lemma H PROVEN; Lemma R PROVEN from card-verified data; Theorem M8 PROVEN from RECORDED data; Case-B census RECORDED. They are not re-derived here; `Q(p)` and `need(p)` are recomputed by `c1`.
* **Not claimed / not re-run:** `p = 47` with `m ≤ 7` stays open. The other ≈10⁴ leaf proofs are not shipped (tens of GB); their verdicts are RECORDED, regenerable on demand.
* **Overlap:** a search of PR bodies found no other closure of these punctures; #939 / #1171 treat star label decoders, a different class.

Package: `research/punctured-e8-48-56/` (README with PROVEN / CHECKED / RECORDED labels, `verify.sh`, `checks/`, `sat/`, `data/`, `evidence/`, `MANIFEST.sha256`, `SOURCES.json`).
